summary: Detected unknown stack with pnpm package manager.
init --agent all on this repo: .gitignore reported as 'overwritten' when agent-flow only appended its entries; label is misleading
onboard on this repo (TypeScript CLI: commander, vitest, tsc) reports 'Detected stack: none'; detection only knows five frameworks (DETECT-01)
init writes .claude/settings.json next to a pre-existing .claude/settings.local.json but does not ignore the local file; 'git add .claude' would commit personal permissions

Router false positive: task 1.2 (tiny init change) routed to deep because an acceptance text mentions 'doctor --tokens' and RISKY_WORDING matches 'token' inside a flag name; pinned tier light. Risky-wording should skip CLI flags/paths or require word boundaries

Pack false positives: tasks 3.1/3.2 (a usage report command) matched persistence, auth-secrets, randomness and http-api packs on keywords (stats file, token, report); waived per task. Pack matching needs scope-aware signals (files under src/ that import http/fs) or negative keywords
Completed 1.1 — Commit the agent-flow setup for this repo (phase 1: Dogfood: agent-flow runs on itself); gates green

Claude Code loads .claude/agents at session start: right after init --claude in a running session, /flow-orchestrate cannot spawn flow-executor-* or flow-reviewer (agent type not found). Skill and README should say: restart the session (or /clear is not enough) after init; the skill could fall back to general-purpose with the agent body

Pack false positives again on plan validate: setup task 1.1 and init task 1.2 matched auth-secrets and randomness ('settings', 'token' in acceptance text); waived both packs on both tasks. Five of eleven v0.11 tasks needed waives for packs that do not apply
Completed 1.2 — init: honest .gitignore label and ignore Claude Code local settings (phase 1: Dogfood: agent-flow runs on itself); gates green

Follow-up: Claude Code did pick up .claude/agents later in the same session (flow-reviewer was usable for the re-review); the gap is only right after init. Skill should say 'if the agent type is not found yet, retry in a moment or restart'
Completed 2.1 — Detect plain Node/TypeScript projects, test runners, lint and typecheck (phase 2: Project detection beyond five frameworks); gates green

Manual acceptance checks against the global CLI ran stale dist: gates run vitest/tsc from src, but 'agent-flow onboard' executes dist/. Build before manual checks on this repo (or add build to the task gates)
Completed 2.2 — Detect Python, Go and Rust projects with their commands (phase 2: Project detection beyond five frameworks); gates green
Detected Node, TypeScript with pnpm package manager.

SQLite WAL side files .agent-flow/memory.db-shm and memory.db-wal show up as untracked after memory queries; GITIGNORE_ENTRIES only ignores memory.db. Should ignore .agent-flow/memory.db* (small fix, candidate for a quick task)
Completed 2.3 — List monorepo workspaces as packages with their own commands (phase 2: Project detection beyond five frameworks); gates green

Phase 2 review needed three rounds: round 1 caught a real unmet criterion (turbo.json) plus hardening; round 2 passed all criteria but failed on hardening alone (workspace cap, yaml edge cases, test hygiene, leading-dash names). The reviewer's 'default to fail' rubric is strict; worth a config knob (review.strictness) or a 'needs-attention' verdict that does not block when criteria are met
